external_reviews.text:
The shop owner was very nice and polite when I ordered the gate, but the after-sales service is terrible. They scheduled three visits to fix the problem, and although I let them schedule the dates and times, they made me wait all day. I called, and they said they were on their way, but after two hours, they still hadn't arrived. If they weren't going to come or fix the problem, they should have just told the customer directly, instead of making an appointment and then going silent. I was the customer who had to contact them. And to this day, no one has come to fix the problem (even though they said they would compensate me for my wasted time).
Another thing is, they said the stainless steel they use won't rust, but after the first New Year's rain, rust is already starting to appear. Anyone considering using their services should be careful. Personally, I don't recommend them because I had a very bad experience.

external_reviews.text: Shipping from Bangkok to Chonburi for delivery to a customer took 5 days. They said it was express delivery, but after 5 days, they said there was a lot of work and the driver was new, so please understand. Have you considered the customer's losses and the customer's frustration at the destination? They called every day, and were told it would be delivered tomorrow, but it wasn't. The customer waited every day, and the sender couldn't collect the payment. The shipping company pocketed the shipping fees without delivering the goods. If you're going to offer this kind of service, you need to be more responsible regarding delivery times. If you're not ready, just close down. The customer is suffering.
The delivery was very good. The delivery staff were very friendly.

Friendly Amenn 'guys' 🙂 guide and generally well organised. It’s a fairly standard route, so it’s busy in places, and insanely so around high tide.
Lunch was pretty good, as expected for Thailand tbh. Would have preferred a bit more time on the islands, but it was a half day.
Snorkelling was pleasant, only one stop but saw loads. Also good if you don’t want to spend most of the day on a boat like some of the longer tours.
Overall, a decent way to see the main spots in a day.

Superbly well co-ordinated & managed. We took a day tour of the Phi Phi islands by speedboat. The entire staff knows exactly what to inform the tourists. We had no questions as they already informed everything we wanted to know. Mr Alex who was our guide for the trip was extremely nice & jovial. He showed us exactly where we need to see to get the beautiful views. Tour included snorkelling too (deep & shallow waters). He showed us few animals on Bamboo island (lizards & crab species). A few of us fell sick because of the bouncing boat ride out to the ocean. They had medicines for that too. We dint spend a penny on the island as meals were included and we could have from the buffet because of our wrist band. Superbly managed by good people.

Today we went on an excursion with Alex in boat 1 to Hong Island. We had both sun and clouds, and we absolutely loved the experience. We’re really happy with the excursion and the service. Alex is a very nice and attentive guy who keeps the …

It was fantastic trip to the 4 islands, excellent speedboat, the captain - Alex the greatest and kindest of all, gave us a fun adventure in sea and beautiful sandy beaches, showed us caves a lots of view points. Hope to make this trip again

Alex, our guide is a really good and hard working guy, so funny and also helpful with tips/recommendations/photos. He really loves his job. Also a good model for all of us, that he calls us “family” not only to keep us together. Our trip to Phi-Phi island was amazing, with so many stops, so many direct explications what to do and what to not. Also have to mention that the boat driver had really good driving skills. The food included was tasty, Alex reserved tables for all of us.
Great job! Wish you all the good!

On 1st island reached 10 minutes late to the boat after exploring  due to natures call. The main guide started shouting very heavily in front of everyone while the boat was bethed. We didn’t even retaliate still he carried this on throughout the trip. He was continuously pointing me out and shouting in front of everyone on us, this totally spoiled our 4 island tour. People take this trip, due to cheaper prices, but believe me it will be very bad experience if the-guides are not friendly or well mannered, plus felt damn congrsted, very less time on each stop, food was ok. We then next booked our tour with sea eagle for hong islands. Damn it chnaged our perspective about island tours - Super chilled guides, extremely friendly, very welcoming, good food and beverages, enough strolling time at every stop, very professional, they do extra beyond what you would as for, that you would not want to leave without tippingthem, such great guys.

The only thing that we’re sorry about is when we came home, we found out that we …

Thank you for everything make our holiday really wonderful and drove us safely to the accommodation 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻
My family and I joined the trip to 4 islands. We ride the boat as last person, and the boat already full and no empty space. …

The company is very good, but some of the security guards' words and actions look down on those working inside. I'd like them to improve their behavior. Even though they are a company that hired them, they should be able to give them a warning.

Before, when I worked for a private company, I used to order water from delivery trucks that came to my house, which was convenient. But after retiring at age 60 and staying at home, I started ordering Singha water to drink and use in cooking. The taste wasn't much different from other waters, but after drinking it for the past two years, I've noticed a change. I feel healthier, more refreshed, and my skin is brighter. Since then, I've only drunk Singha water. Thank you for producing such a beneficial product and allowing me to receive the good things from Singha water.

external_reviews.text: No matter how many times she delivers, the female employee with heavy makeup is always unwelcoming and likes to kick the packages with her feet. Her behavior is truly appalling.
The person who wrote the bill spoke very rudely. He actually gave me the money.

The employee who writes the delivery receipts is terrible. Their attitude and demeanor are completely unsuitable for a customer service job. I've delivered goods several times, and they haven't improved. They're still very rude. If they don't want to do this job, they should find something else. They probably think it's not their company and just go through the motions. Does the company really need someone like this to serve customers? I recommend replacing them. Otherwise, the company will suffer even more because no one will use your services anymore. I'm very disappointed.

external_reviews.reviewer: อ.ยอด ชายทุ่ง
external_reviews.text:
The female bill writer (at the secondary branch) was rude.
She refused to write down the product list for customers. When customers asked her to write it down, she made a face. They would only write the quantity of bundles or boxes, then place the bill down and walk away.

The female employee was arrogant, spoke rudely, and miscalculated the price. She said the price was the same as before, but this time, even though the weight was less but over 10 centimeters taller, she charged extra despite being told the weight was less. I won't use her service again if she treats customers like this. Remember, there are many delivery companies, not just yours. With employees like this, it's no wonder you don't get many customers. Does the owner even know this?

The female employee writing bills at the secondary branch seems unwilling to come to work. Out of 10 points, I'd only give her 1%. She makes faces like she doesn't want to come to work, and this has happened many times without any improvement.
It would be nice if someone could help lift them. Each sack weighs 100 kilos, and there are 5-6 sacks. There's no kindness at all. I paid for the delivery; I wasn't asking for it to be free.
Fast delivery, quick service (inexpensive delivery to Chiang Mai).

external_reviews.reviewer: เมา จังกู

external_reviews.text: Our AC stopped being cold suddenly one morning on our trip here to Bangkok. The manager, who as a bonus speaks great English, was very friendly and helpful. They were able to fix our AC system even though some of the parts had to be modified for our foreign made car. They even did an express job for us since we needed to leave Bangkok

Come here to get oil changed for my old Toyota. The lady who was a supervisor was very friendly and helpful. I called first to check if it was okay to bring my oil instead of using the shop's and she said okay. The guy who gave the service to my car was very attentive and polite. I paid 200 baht for the labor as I brought the oil and filter. Highly recommended.

Last time I visited was January, 2024, the lady who helped me last August wasn't there. There was a man who welcomed me when I arrived. However, when I told him I wanted to get the oil changed for my old Toyota, he said no! I tried to tell him that last time I got here and it could be done, he insisted that the shop would provide the oil change service only for in-house oil, no oil bought from outside is allowed! So, really disappointed.
Nice staff, good service, explained my issue clearly.
Tire replacement and wheel balancing service. Friendly service, standard prices, and good advice. Parking space is a bit limited. Located on Rama VI Road, next to Pradipat intersection.

I do not recommend using this company. I booked my ticket more than two weeks in advance, reserving a minibus and selecting my seats. On the actual day, I got a regular bus.

This is absolutely terrible. I went to file an insurance claim. My car has comprehensive insurance (Class 1), but the dealership demanded a deductible of over 2000 baht. I was confused, so I took it to a local garage. The dealership ordered the parts, but it's taking forever, so long that the garage had to check on it.

In short, the dealership refused to release the parts, insisting on repairs at their service center. And do you know what I find unacceptable? They're charging an exorbitant price for the parts. The insurance agent called to inform me, saying that with my Class 1 insurance, there's no way I'd have to pay a deductible – they're charging way too much. Think twice before buying a car from this dealership. And there's more! When I went to file the claim, the mechanic said they couldn't finish it in time and told me to come back another day, even though I'd already scheduled an appointment with the dealership and taken time off work!

The staff were nice, very nice actually, but the manager or someone in charge of claims or calculating parts costs needs to improve their service. Don't just focus on making money; think about the customers. Charging such excessive prices for parts... Don't you offer any customer service when customers come for repairs and claims? And the car was bought from your dealership!

external_reviews.reviewer: ป้าปริก จิกเด็กตาย
external_reviews.text:
- The shrimp are truly fresh and live, scooped directly from the pond. The meat is delicious and very sweet. We ordered 4 shrimp with the heads removed for only 230 baht (700/kg). We ordered half a kilo of the 460/kg size grilled shrimp. The meat was crispy and not mushy.
The dipping sauce was tasty, with a tangy flavor. For us, we think the dipping sauce could be a little better.
-*** The steamed squid with lime is a must-order. The lime flavor is incredibly strong and spicy, so sour it'll make your brain tingle. This dish is very rice-heavy. The squid is fresh and bouncy, and it's very cheap at only 159 baht for a large one.
- The cockles came as pictured. We think there was a lot for the price, about 30-40 cockles, but about 10 of them smelled bad. Compared to the price of 159 baht, it's acceptable.
- The glass noodle casserole at this restaurant uses a lot of black pepper. If you like black pepper, you'll love it. It's fragrant with pepper, but personally, I don't really like black pepper recipes that much. The taste was a bit bland. For 139 baht, the quantity is very generous, with about 6 shrimp, which is good.
- The restaurant atmosphere is open air, and the owner provides good service. But the staff member might have been confused, perhaps because they didn't understand Thai.

Overall, I'd like to give it 4.5, but there's no .5 option to select.

The shrimp salad, grilled shrimp, and tom yum soup with ruby ​​snapper were all delicious. We arrived around 4 PM and the food came quickly; we didn't have to wait long. The restaurant was clean, mosquito-free, and didn't smell of smoke. I really appreciated the privacy. The prices were moderate for salaried employees. Unfortunately, we were observing the Buddhist Lent, so we'll definitely come back after it ends. 😊🤓💕
